resources.string: Every account has its own keys, settings and session; one is connected at a time. Switching reconnects, and the account you leave stays signed in. The first account cannot be renamed or removed, and the active one cannot be removed.
\"Use networks\" is off in Settings → Account: this device reaches none of the networks and exit nodes that peers route for.
The proxy reaches the phone through NetBird, so peers must be allowed to reach its services. Turn it on in Settings.
